# March 2026

## 2026-03-02 — Firmware 1.6.1 rollout begins

Started pushing 1.6.1 to the stations in reach of a direct connection first, holding
off on the harder-to-reach sites until the first batch had run a few days without
trouble. No regressions reported from the early batch by the end of the week, so the
rest of the network was queued up to follow through the month rather than all at
once.

## 2026-03-07 — Site survey, upper east ridge

Walked the ground above AWS-08 with the idea of a thirteenth station to fill the gap
on the east side. Exposure looked promising and there's a fence post line that would
make mounting straightforward, but access is a genuine problem: the nearest gate is
locked and the landowner hasn't been traced yet. Noted as promising but not
actionable until the access question is sorted.

## 2026-03-14 — Failed gauge swap at AWS-06

Went up to swap the rain gauge at AWS-06 after it failed calibration for the second
time, but the replacement gauge brought along turned out to be the wrong mounting
bracket for that station's mast clamp. Had to leave the old gauge in place rather
than fit something that wouldn't sit level, and the correct bracket has gone on the
list for the next trip up that side of the valley.

## 2026-03-18 — Site survey, lower meadow

Second survey of the month, this time down near the collector, looking at a possible
thirteenth or fourteenth site closer to the valley bottom. Landowner permission here
looks straightforward since it's the same farm as two existing stations, but the
exposure is marginal - there's a line of trees to the south-west that would shade the
panel for a good part of the afternoon in winter. Held over for a second look once
the leaves are off in autumn.

## 2026-03-21 — Radio trouble after the weekend storm

A band of wind and heavy rain came through over the 20th and 21st, and three stations
on the western side dropped frames intermittently for about a day afterwards, all
showing the radio CRC error rather than going fully silent. Put down to a combination
of wet foliage between hops and one antenna mount that had shifted slightly in the
wind; the mount was straightened on the next visit and the frame drops cleared up on
their own once the ground dried out.

## 2026-03-24 — Enclosure redesign work starts

Kicked off proper design work on a reworked enclosure aimed at the water problem that
keeps coming back: vents, a breather membrane, a sloped lid, and moving the desiccant
to somewhere it can actually be checked without a screwdriver. Nothing built yet,
just the first pass at what's changing and why, written up separately as its own
working document.

## 2026-03-29 — Battery check round

Routine voltage check across all twelve stations ahead of the last stretch of winter.
Everything read within the expected range except AWS-09, which was a little lower
than the rest of the group but not yet at a level worth swapping; flagged to keep an
eye on over the next round rather than acted on immediately.
